LESSON: GUIDED WRITING

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: GERMAN
Strand: Writing
Topic 3.7: Guided Writing

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Guided Writing. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why is writing important?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify specific words and phrases for enhancing language learning
2. appreciate the role of words and phrases in writing
3. recognize appropriate vocabulary for communication
4. write texts for effective communication

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: GUIDED WRITING
Subject: GERMAN · Grade: Grade 8
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Guided Writing helps you succeed in GERMAN. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

KEY FACTS: GUIDED WRITING
Language skills grow by daily practice: listen carefully, speak clearly, read every day, write neatly.
Model → guided practice → independent practice.
Always use complete sentences when writing answers.

PART 1: Identify specific words and phrases for enhancing language learning

What this means
In this part you learn to identify specific words and phrases for enhancing language learning. You will use ideas from at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: identify specific words and phrases for enhancing language learning.
2. Listen, speak, read, then write using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Model reading: Read a short paragraph about “Guided Writing”, then retell it in 3 sentences.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can identify specific words and phrases for enhancing language learning. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Appreciate the role of words and phrases in writing

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate the role of words and phrases in writing. You will use ideas from at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate the role of words and phrases in writing.
2. Listen, speak, read, then write using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Model speaking: Say 4 clear sentences about Guided Writing to a partner.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate the role of words and phrases in writing. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Recognize appropriate vocabulary for communication

What this means
In this part you learn to recognize appropriate vocabulary for communication. You will use ideas from at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: recognize appropriate vocabulary for communication.
2. Listen, speak, read, then write using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Model writing: Write 5 neat sentences using new words from this lesson.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can recognize appropriate vocabulary for communication. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 4: Write texts for effective communication

What this means
In this part you learn to write texts for effective communication. You will use ideas from at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: write texts for effective communication.
2. Listen, speak, read, then write using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Model reading: Read a short paragraph about “Guided Writing”, then retell it in 3 sentences.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can write texts for effective communication. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Guided Writing is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Read a short paragraph about “Guided Writing”, then retell it in 3 sentences. (skill: identify specific words and phrases for enhancing language learning)

Example 2: Say 4 clear sentences about Guided Writing to a partner. (skill: appreciate the role of words and phrases in writing)

Example 3: Write 5 neat sentences using new words from this lesson. (skill: recognize appropriate vocabulary for communication)

Example 4: Read a short paragraph about “Guided Writing”, then retell it in 3 sentences. (skill: write texts for effective communication)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Guided Writing to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: identify specific words and phrases for enhancing language learning.
3. Practise this skill: appreciate the role of words and phrases in writing.
4. Practise this skill: recognize appropriate vocabulary for communication.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Guided Writing from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Guided Writing: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 8 learner study Guided Writing?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is writing important?
2. Why is it important to write things down?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Guided Writing means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: identify specific words and phrases for enhancing language learning.
5. Be able to: appreciate the role of words and phrases in writing.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
